summary: OddOneGaming provides a complete guide for Temporal Vortex Difficulty IV in Season 8 featuring Aura and Toxic dual teams. He details boss mechanics, positioning tricks for egg AoE clear, ultimate skill timings, and individual gear builds for all ten heroes. The showcase demonstrates achieving over 4.7 billion total damage using balanced team compositions.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.verdict: Core shield provider for Aura team
heroes.note: Built with full Enlightenment and Aurelum Vest to generate massive shields and team damage reduction.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.verdict: Essential cleanser and tank for Aura team
heroes.note: Built for max HP with Sylvan Refuge and Solar King's Horn to absorb single-target boss execution hits and cleanse debuffs.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Stacked with maximum Attack using Orb of the Dragon God and Everlasting Candleflame to share Attack stats with Talethia.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.verdict: Debuffer and support for Aura team
heroes.note: Equipped with Witch's Remains to apply Defense Penalty II alongside shared attack support gear.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Built for high Crit Rate and Crit Damage with Dragonblood Brand to convert bonus HP into Attack.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.verdict: Debuffer and healer for Toxic team
heroes.note: Uses Whirling Doom and high HP to apply attack and recharge speed penalties while extending Durango's Defense penalty.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.verdict: Healer and shield generator for Toxic team
heroes.note: Equipped with Gatekeeper's Staff and high Enlightenment to convert overhealing into team shields.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.verdict: Debuffer and Accuracy aura provider for Toxic team
heroes.note: Provides Accuracy Aura and Defense Penalty while wearing Death Record to boost derivative damage taken by the boss.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Uses Illuya's Fang and Darknight Canticle to maximize Toxin application rate across all spawned eggs.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Requires around 140-150 Accuracy along with high Enlightenment and Statue of the Serpent Deity to deal massive Poison derivative damage.

teams.note: Focuses on positioning Anneliesis in front of Solmo to repeatedly grant her shields while she tanks execution hits and cleanses debuffs at 30.1s.
Positioned centrally so diamond-shape AoE attacks from Twitch and Durango hit all spawned eggs in a line.

meta_changes: Temporal Vortex Season 8 allows swapping affinity and accuracy buffs between boss phases.
Hydra egg spawn tile restrictions require specific hero positioning for diamond AoE skills to hit all targets.
tips: Stack Accuracy on your highest accuracy hero to gain up to 20% team-wide Damage Reduction from the season buff.
Delay Anneliesis's first cast to 30.1s so she cleanses the boss's ATK and DEF penalties immediately after they land.
Ensure Serpentemis has at least 140-150 Accuracy so her passive consistently lands Serpent Venom stacks.
